task: Implement a small independent Python semantic action codec for switch-reference-1. You own only python/pokemon_switch/contract.py and tests/switch-reference/test_contract.py. You are not alone: do not edit or revert other files, and do not delegate recursively. API mask(request) returns exactly four booleans; command(request,index) returns move 1/move 2/switch current-position; reject invalid or boolean indices and illegal actions. Read profile and contract. Handle stock Showdown wait requests ({wait:true}), singles move requests, and forceSwitch:[true]. Validate two own Pokemon with idents p1: A/B or p2: A/B, matching side.id, one active member, no duplicates; current request order may reverse. Reject unsupported Tera, trap, reviving, teamPreview, extra active dimensions, malformed PP or disabled flags, Struggle, unknown move IDs or move count. Use profile species/details to require the two allowed active move IDs in declared order; tolerate normal legitimate Showdown request metadata. Wait has empty mask; force switch only bench living. Tests must prove stable original identities after reorder, forced/wait handling, PP disable and zero, malformed/out-of-scope requests, and rejection before command generation. Standard library only; no dependency installation or external queries.
criteria: Both files only; independent four-action codec with stable identities; meaningful negative tests; no changes to profile or existing sealed implementation; focused unittest passes.
